entities.summary: Mojtaba Mirzajanpour Muziraji is an Iranian volleyball player, a member of the Iran national team and Iranian Volleyball Super League club Shahrdari Varamin. He competed at the 2014 World Championship and Rio 2016 Summer Olympics. Mirzajanpour debut national game in 2013 Grand Championship did with invitations Julio Velasco.
